## Design

### 2026-10-05 — Created the schematic, then routed the board. I have yet to test it. Im going to try to get feedback on it from my friend who knowsmore then me. I wasted a good 45 mins trying to make a perfect star,

**3.3h**

Created the schematic, then routed the board. I have yet to test it. Im going to try to get feedback on it from my friend who knowsmore then me. I wasted a good 45 mins trying to make a perfect star, but then gave up and made my own version of a blocky star. I plan to add mounting holes to the design for future purposes as theres is space.

**1.9h**

I worked on the PCB more now. I spent a good bit of time designing this shooting star pattern. Im hopping that the main board being behind the display wont be a problem, as well as there being no ground fill. Otherwise a slightly moved some compenents to make the board look better. ### 2026-10-06 — Variations!!

**1.2h**

Variations!!

I decided that I would use the time I had this morning to work on my skills. More specifically my pcb routing skills. I routed a left button and right button variaty of my starbie. I had to move a few compents to fit the buttons in their spots however I think that the staarbies have kept their clean design.

Last night I read the journal guide. They are asking for alot, not something thats impossible, however it seems like something I would not look forward to. It kinda feels like an ELA class, which is something I want to get away from whilst doing these projects. However I will still try my best to make a nice journal.

I also added a few new decals in different spots to cover up the space from where the compenents where moved.
